text:
maria: Heads-up — I just published a minor SDK change that tightened our package exports map and it caused a bunch of sample apps to fail on the Edge runtime (CloudFlare/Workers-style). Error is `TypeError: require is not defined` coming from a transitive dep expecting the CJS fallback.

maria: My change was to switch exports from the permissive form to explicit conditional exports so bundlers prefer ESM:

maria: ```json
maria: "exports": {
maria:   ".": {"import":"./dist/index.mjs","require":"./dist/index.cjs"},
maria:   "./feature": {"import":"./dist/feature.mjs"}
maria: }
maria: ```

sam: Hmm - Edge environments sometimes only resolve the `import` condition and then bundlers/runtime try to inline ESM-only bits. Did the change remove the `require` path for `./feature`? :thinking:

maria: Yes — I didn't add a `require` fallback for `./feature` because it's ESM-only. Locally node and bundlers were fine, but on the Edge runtime the worker shim expects a CJS entry or throws.

ryan: Also check `types`/`typesVersions` in package.json — TS resolution can pick a different file for `import` vs `require`. We had a report of failures where IDEs couldn't find typings after the export map became conditional. Quick fix: add explicit "require":"./dist/feature.cjs" for subpath or add a top-level "./feature": {"default":"./dist/feature.cjs","import":"./dist/feature.mjs"}

sam: Another option is to keep the source entrypoint "./" with a generic default that points to CJS, and have ESM consumers use the `import` condition. That preserves compatibility for older edge runtimes.

deploy-bot: CI failed on sample-apps/integrations/edge-worker — https://ci.internal/12345 — stack: TypeError: require is not defined

maria: Rolling back the PR for now. I'll open a follow-up that (1) restores a CJS fallback for subpaths used by our samples, (2) adds a test that runs a minimal worker bundle, and (3) documents the guidance for package `exports` -> edge compatibility in the SDK README. Sorry for the churn :face_with_head_bandage:

ryan: sounds good. we should also add a lint rule to warn about subpath exports lacking `require` fallback when `main` still points to CJS. I can prototype.

sam: If anyone's blocked on the sample apps ping me and I can patch them to import from the `.cjs` subpath until a permanent fix.

maria: thanks. I'll follow up with the PR and link the rollback.
